mechanism: Lansoprazole inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing fluphenazine metabolism inhibition and plasma concentrations, while fluphenazine may increase anticholinergic effects and CNS depression when combined with lansoprazole's minor anticholinergic properties.
action: Monitor for increased fluphenazine adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, anticholinergic effects); consider fluphenazine dose reduction if toxicity occurs; baseline and periodic EPS assessment recommended.
